# Video Conference Service

## Purpose
The Video Conference Service provides integration with external video conferencing platforms (such as Jitsi). It manages the creation and tracking of virtual meeting rooms, sessions, and participants, enabling real-time video communication capabilities within the FlexiCore ecosystem.

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Room** | `/plugins/Room/getAllRooms` | POST | Lists all virtual rooms. |
| **VideoServer** | `/plugins/VideoServer/getAllVideoServers` | POST | Lists configured video servers. |
| **VideoServerUser**| `/plugins/VideoServerUser/getAllVideoServerUsers` | POST | Lists users registered on servers. |

## Dependencies
- **video-conference-model**: Core entities for servers and rooms.
- **flexicore-boot**: Plugin infrastructure.

## Interesting Features
- **Server Abstraction**: Can manage multiple video conferencing backends from a single interface.
- **Room Persistence**: Links virtual rooms to system entities, allowing for audit and access control.

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as RoomController
    participant Service as RoomService

    User->>Controller: createRoom(RoomCreate)
    Controller->>Service: createRoom(RoomCreate)
    Service-->>User: Room Created with Server Link
```
